title: Beyond Factual Grounding: The Case for Opinion-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation
authors: Aditya Agrawal; Alwarappan Nakkiran; Darshan Fofadiya; Alex Karlsson; Harsha Aduri
why_relevant: Frames opinion vs factual queries through epistemic/aleatoric uncertainty and notes how RAG treats opinions as noise, tangentially relating to uncertainty and diversity in retrieval.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on opinion synthesis architecture, not robustness, calibration, conflicts, or adversarial issues central to the survey.
